descriptionChirho: Qal: to cry out in distress, anguish, or supplication; to call aloud to God or to another person for aid or attention.
Nifal: to be summoned or called together as a group; to assemble in response to a call or proclamation.
Hifil: to cause people to assemble by issuing a summons; to call together or convoke a group.
Hifil: to cause a cry or message to go forth; to proclaim publicly or cry out with authority.
